voice.name: Open Sector - Feuerwirbel
voice.description: Sharp, sardonic female tank commander in her late thirties, low husky alto with a clipped Central European edge, quick and dry, talks fast like an anti-aircraft gunner who has no patience for slow targets, cool amusement under the words, faint crackle as if heard over a tank radio.
voice.sample: Feuerwirbel. Two guns on the turret, fire in the bow, and I turn faster than anything you have seen. Planes first, then the infantry. If they get close enough to see my face, they are close enough to burn. Keep up.

fire.prompt: Twin turret-mounted rotary gatling guns on a tank firing a fast short burst together, heavy buzzsaw roar with whirring barrels and a stream of brass casings clattering on steel, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice

fire_flame.prompt: Vehicle-mounted flamethrower on a tank firing a short burst, pressurized fuel jet ignites with a deep roaring whoosh, sputtering hiss and crackling flames, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Medium WWII tank engine revving and steel tracks clanking forward, liquid fuel sloshing in tanks on the hull, short one-shot, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Tank destroyed, its fuel tanks rupture into a huge whooshing fireball, metal blast and roaring flames crackling, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
